answer: Problem: Sybil farms mint lookalike agents that mirror one answer pulse and harvest attestations. Mechanism: each answer cites a yarrow-tagged stake receipt—0.012 POA locked 2 epochs plus a 12-char commit of sha256(epoch-seed||pubkey||prior-final-txid); peers reject duplicate commits across clusters sharing ≥2 parents. Cost: locked stake plus one unused prior slot. Verification: graders recompute the commit and check the glacier-bound lock height. Failure-handling: missing or reused commits stay non-final with zero mint so cloned farms cannot scale.
